psalm-49-1.verse: Hear this, all peoples; Give ear, all inhabitants of the world,
psalm-49-1.prayer: Lord, help me listen carefully to Your wisdom and apply Your truth to my life.

psalm-49-2.verse: Both low and high, Rich and poor together.
psalm-49-2.prayer: Father, remind me that Your Word is for all people, regardless of status, wealth, or position.

psalm-49-3.verse: My mouth will speak wisdom, And the meditation of my heart will be understanding.
psalm-49-3.prayer: Lord, fill my heart with wisdom and understanding that comes from knowing You.

psalm-49-4.verse: I will incline my ear to a proverb; I will express my riddle on the harp.
psalm-49-4.prayer: Father, help me seek Your truth and grow in spiritual discernment every day.

psalm-49-5.verse: Why should I fear in days of adversity, When the iniquity of my foes surrounds me,
psalm-49-5.prayer: Lord, when fear surrounds me, help me trust in Your presence and protection.

psalm-49-6.verse: Even those who trust in their wealth And boast in the abundance of their riches?
psalm-49-6.prayer: Father, keep me from placing confidence in wealth, possessions, or worldly success.

psalm-49-7.verse: No man can by any means redeem his brother Or give to God a ransom for him—
psalm-49-7.prayer: Lord, remind me that no earthly resource can purchase salvation. Thank You for the gift of redemption through Your grace.

psalm-49-8.verse: For the redemption of his soul is costly, And he should cease trying forever—
psalm-49-8.prayer: Father, thank You that true redemption comes from You alone and cannot be earned by human effort.

psalm-49-9.verse: That he should live on eternally, That he should not undergo decay.
psalm-49-9.prayer: Lord, help me live with an eternal perspective rather than focusing only on temporary things.

psalm-49-10.verse: For he sees that even wise men die; The stupid and the senseless alike perish And leave their wealth to others.
psalm-49-10.prayer: Father, remind me that earthly life is brief and that wisdom is found in preparing for eternity.

psalm-49-11.verse: Their inner thought is that their houses are forever And their dwelling places to all generations; They have called their lands after their own names.
psalm-49-11.prayer: Lord, help me avoid placing my identity in accomplishments, possessions, or reputation.

psalm-49-12.verse: But man in his pomp will not endure; He is like the beasts that perish.
psalm-49-12.prayer: Father, teach me humility and remind me that all earthly glory fades away.

psalm-49-13.verse: This is the way of those who are foolish, And of those after them who approve their words. Selah.
psalm-49-13.prayer: Lord, keep me from foolish pride and help me walk in wisdom and dependence upon You.

psalm-49-14.verse: As sheep they are appointed for Sheol; Death shall be their shepherd; And the upright shall rule over them in the morning, And their form shall be for Sheol to consume So that they have no habitation.
psalm-49-14.prayer: Father, thank You for showing me the path that leads to eternal life and hope.

psalm-49-15.verse: But God will redeem my soul from the power of Sheol, For He will receive me. Selah.
psalm-49-15.prayer: Lord, thank You for redeeming my soul and giving me the promise of everlasting life with You.

psalm-49-16.verse: Do not be afraid when a man becomes rich, When the glory of his house is increased;
psalm-49-16.prayer: Father, help me remain content and faithful when others prosper materially.

psalm-49-17.verse: For when he dies he will carry nothing away; His glory will not descend after him.
psalm-49-17.prayer: Lord, remind me that earthly possessions cannot be taken into eternity and that true treasure is found in You.

psalm-49-18.verse: Though while he lives he congratulates himself— And though men praise you when you do well for yourself—
psalm-49-18.prayer: Father, keep me from seeking the praise of people more than the approval of You.

psalm-49-19.verse: He shall go to the generation of his fathers; They will never see the light.
psalm-49-19.prayer: Lord, help me live wisely and faithfully so that my life reflects eternal values.

psalm-49-20.verse: Man in his pomp, yet without understanding, Is like the beasts that perish.
psalm-49-20.prayer: Father, grant me understanding and help me walk according to Your wisdom rather than the wisdom of the world.

psalm-49-closing.verse:
Lord, thank You for teaching me what truly matters. Help me live with an eternal perspective and place my trust in You rather than in wealth, possessions, or worldly success. Fill me with wisdom, humility, and contentment. Thank You for redeeming my life and giving me the hope of eternity with You. May my heart remain focused on Your kingdom and Your purposes above all else.

In Jesus’ name, Amen. 🙏🏻
